author: Codex
requested_mechanism: This invocation is the actual BM256 compilation experiment. Start from accepted fb1233ed source,400.21285us. Only change host BLOCK_M selection for noncausal BF16 with D<=128 and S>=256 from128 to256. Keep BLOCK_N128 and the complete kernel function computational AST unchanged. Keep shorterS, FP16 and causal paths as accepted. Do not substitute widerN, SINGLE_KV, peeling, or another mechanism. Submit this exact metadata experiment for external compilation; a real compiler failure is a useful result. Untested UB/L0C estimates are predictions and must not cancel the requested experiment. If you cannot make this change, hand off a no-change explanation instead of a replacement experiment.
analysis: 明确续接004已验收400.21285μs。006模型依据未经本版编译的M256资源估算改选了N256＋SINGLE_KV，实际候选正在独立评测；本调用补齐原指定M256实验，仅改变宿主分块选择，保持BN128及kernel计算AST。目标program512→256，总L0C→GM128MiB预计保持，GM→L1按M相关Q/概率与固定K/V估算224→320KiB/program、全kernel112→80MiB；编译器额外缓冲可能改变资源与真实计数。L0C/UB的后端分块、双Vector分工与生命周期由编译结果给出，实际失败与资源字节需求需要保留。模型5的BM128/BN256原两项PV已经实测编译及四项通过，目标416.41205μs；该结果和过去的M32/N256负结果均说明不同几何须单独实测。当前原checker、golden、seed、阈值、四项完整输入、计时合同保持；FP16及较短S路径保留。Triton能直接表达本改法，IR只作检查；完整候选继续后profiling与模拟器重放。
